text:
alex_k: Hey team — PR #6340 (https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6340) updates the SDK snippet in the 'private deployments' guide. Legal flagged it for potential credential leakage. Can we coordinate review + redaction?

sara_d: Thanks for the heads up. Is it the example that inlines a `private_key` sample?

katie_docs: Yep, spotted that. The snippet currently shows a `private_key: "-----BEGIN..."` placeholder. Legal wants us to remove any runnable key material.

alex_k: Ok. I can replace with pseudo-code or KMS pointer. Wanted to check merge timing — CI preview is green except docs lint error on the snippet.

docs-ci: Preview URL: <https://deploy-preview-6340--docs.redwood.com> — lint failure: docs/priv-deploy/sdk.md: line 84: inline-key-sample detected.

matt_infra: If legal needs to redact, we should hold the main branch merge. We can still merge non-sensitive fixes in a follow-up. Can we push a quick patch to the PR that swaps the key for a `KMS_URI` example?

legal_reviewer: Can you paste the exact snippet? Need to confirm whether it exposes a real-looking key. If it's clearly fake we may be ok, but best practice is to remove any PEM-like block.

alex_k: Pasting snippet here (original):
```
client_config:
  endpoint: "api.redwood.ai"
  credentials:
    private_key: "-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----\nMIIEvQIBADANBg...\n-----END PRIVATE KEY-----"
```

legal_reviewer: Yep — redact. Replace with a reference to customer-managed KMS or env var. Also add guidance in the paragraph above to never paste keys in docs.

katie_docs: I drafted replacement. Suggestion: use `KMS_URI` + example that calls a `fetch_key_from_kms()` helper. Also will add a short note: "Do not paste private keys; use secrets management."

alex_k: Nice. Can you drop the patch into the PR now? If docs-ci re-runs and green we can merge after legal signoff.

katie_docs: Pushed commit `fix(redaction): replace inline key with kms example` -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/commit/abc123

docs-ci: Re-running checks... lint: pass, build: pass, preview: available -> <https://deploy-preview-6340--docs.redwood.com>

sec_ops_bot: Security review required: high-sensitivity content flagged. Assigned to @legal_reviewer and @matt_infra for ops impact.

matt_infra: Quick ops note: replacing with KMS example doesn't change infra, but flagging for the rollout notes — need to ensure our private deployment guide doesn't imply public KMS for on-prem customers. Katie, can you add a conditional note for on-prem?

katie_docs: On it — will add a short paragraph: "For on-prem or air-gapped deployments, integrate with your KMS/HSM; do not rely on public cloud KMS URIs."

legal_reviewer: Reviewed the new text and code sample. LGTM. Added comment to PR requesting one small wording change in the warning line.

alex_k: Thanks. I applied the wording tweak per legal comment. Anything else blocking?

legal_reviewer: All good from legal. Please ensure the change log includes that we redacted an example key for compliance.

matt_infra: Ops: I'll run a quick smoke test of the changed doc snippet to confirm no broken links. If that passes, we can merge to main during the next low-traffic window (tonight 22:00 PT).

sara_d: Can we do a canary deploy after merge? A minor docs site deploy takes ~5 minutes; would be nice to watch.

matt_infra: Yep — will do a canary and monitor CDN propagation.

alex_k: OK—plan: hold merge until matt does smoke test + canary window tonight 22:00 PT. Legal has approved redaction. Katie, please add the changelog entry and mark the PR ready. I'll ping again 30m before merge. :thumbsup:

katie_docs: Added changelog under `docs/CHANGELOG.md` and marked PR as ready for merge.

docs-ci: All checks passing.

alex_k: Thanks everyone. Will coordinate the 22:00 deploy and drop a note in #release-war-room before merge.

sara_d: Thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround.

sec_ops_bot: Note: post-merge audit will run to confirm no sensitive blobs in repo history. If anything is found, the incident-runbook will trigger.

alex_k: Understood. I'll follow up if audit flags anything. Closing loop here.
